events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Picture it: August 1969, half a million people, three days of peace and music. Woodstock wasn't just a festival; it was a cultural phenomenon. What's your favourite moment or performance from the legendary event?

events.title: Elvis Presley: A Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: King of Rock & Roll
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and iconic style continue to influence generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, succumbing to his injuries days later. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, the world lost a lyrical genius. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful words and raw talent continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac song?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: The Legend Lives On
events.blurb: Guitar virtuoso Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks like "Come Together" and "Something".

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and timeless tracks. What's your favourite song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and the voice of The Pretenders. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam G
angles.copy: Alright, our kid! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. What was your first iPod, and what was on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, leaving an unforgettable musical legacy. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
